trends.name: GTA 6 launch
trends.what: GTA 6 came out Nov 19, 2026 after a 13-year wait. Consoles sold out and people skipped work and pulled all-nighters to play it.
trends.fits: work, school, roommates, siblings, waiting a long time, calling in sick, sold-out stores, anything that took forever
examples: Half the office called in sick that week. GTA 6 came out.
I waited longer for that refund than people waited for GTA 6.

trends.name: In this town
trends.what: A Roblox storytime: 'In this town, everybody goes out partying except me.' Format: 'In this <place>, everybody <does X>. Except me.'
trends.fits: narrator setting up how OP is the odd one out at work, school, a family or a neighborhood
examples: In this office, everybody takes a lunch break. Except me.

trends.name: I got so mad
trends.what: Comment trend about doing something absurdly over the top 'because I got so mad'.
trends.fits: narrator right before OP's petty or malicious-compliance move
examples: I got so mad, I read the entire handbook. Out loud.

trends.name: General Grant on the thermostat
trends.what: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules line, 'What was General Grant doing on the thermostat?' Used for an angry adult demanding answers about something tiny.
trends.fits: a parent, landlord or boss interrogating someone about a small household or office thing
examples: She stared at me like I'd put General Grant on the thermostat.
